data.name: Sol Titan: Echno
data.detailed_description:
You are trapped inside the mind of a mysterious titan. Explore the impossible worlds within it, survive its madness, and find a way out.

Explore Multiple Worlds

Explore bizarre worlds with abnormal gravity, unstable weather and brutal environmental conditions.

Every world is procedurally generated, including its:

  • Biomes

  • Dungeons

  • Creatures

  • Cave systems

  • Settlements

Fight With Precision

Fast, reactive, and skill-focused combat.

Use both primitive and modern melee and ranged weapons
Customize and level up your weapons to unlock new combos, weapon abilities and unexpected evolutions.

Time your attacks, build combo chains, dodge carefully, aim precisely, and master different weapon types as you face a large variety of procedurally generated creatures.

Build, Design and Power

Survival is not only about fighting.

Build your own bases inside the titan’s mind. Reshape the terrain, create safe zones, construct workshops, and build electrical grids with generators, batteries and powered machines.

As you progress, your base can grow from a simple shelter into a massive stronghold, helping you process raw resources into useful materials, craft better tools and weapons, and unlock technology for deeper exploration.

Use Strange Powers

You are not powerless inside this mind.

Experiment with reality-bending abilities to survive, explore, fight, and repair the damaged worlds around you.

Key Features

  • Explore a massive 2D action-adventure sandbox set inside the mind of a titan

  • Procedurally generated worlds, terrain, and biome variation

  • Living worlds with worldwide consequences based on your actions

  • Fast combat using melee and ranged weapons from many different eras

  • Build bases, shape terrain and become a master of infrastructure

  • Discover otherworldly ecosystems, varied settlements, strange civilizations and deep dungeons

  • Unlock powers that allow you to manipulate the building blocks of reality
